integrity: The proof uses the published determinantal model for the jumping scheme and reconstructs the local restriction matrix directly from the published sextic equation. Exact rational linear algebra verifies the rank, invertible block, and quadratic normal minors; Nakayama's lemma gives the local ideal.
scientific_limitations: The calculation determines only the local algebra at the explicit deeper jumping line ell_0. It does not classify other local multiplicities or assert a specific deformation splitting.
title: The deeper jumping line on the explicit sextic has local length three
